mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignment_history (assignment_id, batch_id, student_id, bed_id, event_type, assignment_method, operator_user_id, reason, previous_data, current_data, occurred_at) SELECT assignment.id, assignment.batch_id, assignment.student_id, assignment.bed_id, 'CANCELLED', assignment.assignment_method, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, JSON_OBJECT( 'assignmentId', assignment.id, 'batchId', assignment.batch_id, 'studentId', assignment.student_id, 'bedId', assignment.bed_id, 'assignmentMethod', assignment.assignment_method, 'assignmentStatus', assignment.assignment_status ), JSON_OBJECT('assignmentStatus', 'CANCELLED_BY_CHECKOUT'), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM bed_assignment assignment WHERE assignment.batch_id=#{batchId} AND assignment.student_id=#{studentId} AND assignment.assignment_status='ACTIVE'
